scope: Bounded independent handoff packaging-code review with exact snapshot/alias/member-manifest inspection and 31 small integrity/preservation fixtures

resolved_findings.evidence: Both root and ZIP verifiers now check checksum-table exact membership, no duplicates, SHA format and manifest digest. Missing/corrupt/missing-entry/duplicate/extra/wrong-manifest fixtures reject.

Modified retained files, modified generated navigation and unowned conflicting targets now reject without overwriting their bytes. Unchanged restaging and legitimate updates from the previous manifest pass.

actual_selection_review.scope: Exact member/alias/snapshot checks apply to the recorded pre-fix manifests; fixes change verifier and staging guards only. Final rebuilt archive/member hashes remain the root builder and extraction-validation responsibility.

archive_safety_checks: Safe relative names reject empty/dot/parent/absolute/drive/backslash forms.
Duplicate ZIP members, parent traversal and unmanifested ZIP members reject.
Every manifested payload is size/SHA checked; checksum table also binds the manifest bytes.
Actual Windows canonical member names had no case/trailing-dot collisions or reserved names.
preservation_checks: Builder reads original research and materializes matching working bytes or pinned Git blobs.
Source changes are not silently substituted into committed baseline paths.
Old receipt paths remain intact with explicit exact-content aliases.
Changed/unowned staged payloads reject; unrelated staged additions remain unmodified and unsealed.
This independent audit wrote only owned new handoff receipts/fixtures and did not edit the root builder or frozen research.
limitations: An internal hash manifest is an integrity check, not a digital authenticity signature; the externally recorded ZIP SHA provides the delivered archive identity.
No new annual PF, NYgrid OPF, full-array repetition or archive creation was run by this bounded code review.
The root builder must rebuild and read back final archives containing the fixed utilities.
